pages.text: The Lumenwrights did not climb — they floated. A Lumen Field Projector projects a gravity column from one face: ride it up (Ascension) or safely down (Descent). Right-click to toggle the mode.

A column reaches 16 blocks. Mount a Gravity Repeater flush in the shaft wall and it resets that range, chaining a shaft arbitrarily tall. You'll find these working in the abandoned mines beneath the $(l:vestige_cities)Vestige Cities$(/l) — built from real, reusable parts.
